- Experience developing and delivering internal and external communications strategies
- Strong written communication skills and the ability to create engaging content for different audiences

title: Marketing and Campaigns Coordinator
description:
Great ideas deserve to be brought to life. Could you be the person to make that happen?

£28,000 FTE £12,800 actual salary 16 hours per week Hybrid working Mansfield

We can offer

Flexible part-time hours: 16 hours per week, with the working pattern agreed to suit both you and the business.

Hybrid working: A minimum of 50% of your working hours based at our Mansfield office.

Real involvement: The opportunity to take responsibility for campaigns and see the results of your work.

Support and collaboration: Direct access to the people making business decisions, with opportunities to contribute your own ideas.

Variety: A role that combines creative work, research, planning and practical delivery.

Do you enjoy turning ideas into engaging content? Are you someone who takes pride in the details, likes having a clear plan and gets satisfaction from seeing your work make a difference?

Perhaps you've worked in marketing for a few years and are now looking for a role that offers greater flexibility without losing the opportunity to use your skills, contribute ideas and take ownership of your work.

What makes this opportunity different?

We're not looking for someone to arrive with a completely new marketing strategy or reinvent our business, we already know who our customers are, understand the challenges they face and have developed ideas for campaigns we want to deliver. We need someone who enjoys the practical side of marketing. Someone who can take an idea, think about the best way to communicate it, create the materials, organise the activity and see it through to completion.

You'll have the freedom to be creative, the support of an experienced team and the satisfaction of seeing the results of your work.

What will you be doing?
- Bringing campaigns to life: Turning our marketing ideas into engaging, well-planned campaigns that reach the right businesses.
- Creating great content: Producing LinkedIn posts, graphics, email campaigns, newsletters, brochures and other promotional materials.
- Finding the right audience: Researching prospective customers and understanding the businesses and people we want to engage with.
- Keeping everything organised: Maintaining a marketing calendar, coordinating activities and ensuring campaigns happen when planned.
- Making our message stand out: Finding interesting, clear and professional ways to explain how LivePay helps businesses.
- Seeing what works: Monitoring engagement and campaign results, identifying improvements and sharing your findings.
- Contributing your ideas: Working with our Customer Development Manager and Managing Director to develop and improve our marketing activities.

What experience would help?

Ideally, you'll have some practical experience in marketing, communications, content creation or a similar role. We're looking for someone who brings creativity, enthusiasm and organisation, takes pride in their work and is comfortable taking ownership of tasks, asking questions and listening to feedback.

We'd particularly welcome experience in:
- Creating professional, engaging written content.
- Managing LinkedIn or other business social media campaigns.
- Using Canva or similar design tools.
- Producing email marketing campaigns and promotional materials.
- Researching prospective customers or target audiences.
- Organising marketing activities and managing deadlines.
- Using CRM systems, website tools or marketing analytics.

Experience of business-to-business marketing would be helpful, but it's not essential. You don't need to be an expert in payroll. We'll help you understand our services and our customers.

We're more interested in what you can do, how you approach your work and the pride you take in delivering it than in a long list of qualifications.

A little about us

At LivePay, we've been helping businesses manage their payroll for over 45 years. We're an independent, family-run business with a straightforward approach: combine great technology with knowledgeable, friendly people who genuinely care about the customers they support. We have plenty of experience, lots of knowledge to share and some exciting ideas about how we can reach more businesses.

What we don't have is enough time to bring all those ideas to life. That's where you come in.

Interested? We'd love to see what you can do.

We'd love to hear about your experience and see examples of marketing materials, campaigns or content you've helped create.

Apply with your CV and a short introduction explaining why this role interests you.

Working closely with the Commercial Team, you'll be responsible for driving brand awareness, lead generation, digital marketing performance, and company communications across multiple channels.
Key Responsibilities
- Manage and develop content across social media, email marketing, website, and printed materials.
- Take ownership of the company website, ensuring content is engaging, current, and performance-driven.
- Manage large-scale Google Ads campaigns and analyse performance using Google Analytics.
- Monitor, measure, and report on the effectiveness of all marketing activities, making recommendations to improve performance and ROI.
- Create content including case studies, articles, company news, and marketing literature.
- Generate new business enquiries through targeted and proactive marketing campaigns.
- Plan, coordinate, and prepare for exhibitions, trade shows, conferences, and industry events, with occasional attendance where required.
- Maintain a library of corporate imagery and marketing assets for use across all promotional channels.
- Ensure brand consistency across all marketing materials and communications.
- Support overseas representatives with marketing activities and marketing collateral.
- Work proactively with the Commercial Team to identify opportunities to increase brand awareness and lead generation.

About You
- Previous experience in a Marketing Executive, Digital Marketing, or similar role.
- Strong content creation, communication, and presentation skills.
- A proactive, self-motivated individual who enjoys taking ownership and driving initiatives forward.
- Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret marketing data and identify opportunities for improvement.
- Experience managing business social media channels, particularly LinkedIn.
- Knowledge of Google Analytics, Google Ads, Microsoft Office, and website management.
- Experience with WordPress, Adobe Creative Suite, and AI tools would be advantageous.
- Highly organised with the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities.
- Experience within engineering, manufacturing, or a technical environment would be beneficial.
- Additional Requirements
- Full UK driving licence.
- UK passport and willingness to travel occasionally, including internationally.

Cherry Professional are recruiting for this opportunity on behalf of our client. Please view our Privacy Policy on our website to understand how your data will be used if you apply for this role.

title: Marketing Executive
description:
A Bank on a Mission

Since new ownership in 2020, Kingdom Bank has been rapidly growing. Churches and Christians across the UK are increasingly looking to us because they want their savings to fuel gospel mission and not just sit in a standard high-street account. We're becoming the go-to bank for evangelical churches, Christians and Christian-led businesses, and we're just getting started!

Are You Our New Marketing Executive?

Good with words? Do some good with them.

Are you a creative marketer with a talent for writing content and delivering distinctive campaigns? Would you like to use your skills to help churches grow and support gospel mission across the UK?

Kingdom Bank is looking for a Marketing Executive to join our team. This is a hands-on role focused on delivering marketing activity across campaigns, content, customer communications and digital channels.

Working closely with the Brand and Campaigns Manager, you will create engaging website, email and social media content, support marketing campaigns, develop customer communications and help share the stories that demonstrate the impact of Kingdom Bank's work. You will also work with colleagues across the Bank and external agencies to deliver marketing activity that supports customer acquisition, engagement and growth.

We're looking for a strong communicator with excellent copywriting skills, experience in a marketing or communications role, and the ability to manage multiple priorities with accuracy and attention to detail.

This role would suit someone who is proactive, organised and passionate about driving results.

Give your marketing career a mission.

Occupational Requirement: Kingdom Bank has an occupational requirement under the Equality Act 2010 for the post-holder to be a committed Christian who can actively support and contribute to the Bank's Christian mission, values and culture.

A Small Team With Big Impact

We're a close-knit team of around 60 people - small enough that every individual can shape the Bank's direction. Our culture is hardworking, warm, informal, and passionate about making Jesus known. We trust our people to balance flexibility with responsibility, support one another, and deliver excellent service for our customers. And we invest in our team through training, development, and opportunities to grow and progress.

ROLE

The Marketing Executive plays a key role in delivering Kingdom Bank's marketing activity, providing hands-on support across campaigns, content, customer communications and digital channels. The role combines broad marketing expertise with a particular strength in writing, communication and content creation, enabling the successful execution of marketing plans whilst upholding the Bank's three priorities of Quality, Culture and Growth.

When you'll work

35 hours per week, generally expected to be worked Mondays to Fridays and between 8.30am and 5.30pm. However part-time hours are a consideration in this role. The working pattern will be agreed with the line manager under the Bank's flexible working policy.

27 days (or pro-rata equivalent) paid holiday (excluding bank holidays), and the opportunity to purchase additional holiday up to a maximum entitlement of 32 days per annum.

Where you'll work

The ideal candidate would be able to attend the Bank's office at least once a week, but with a minimum expectation of at least two office-based days per month in accordance with the Bank's flexible working policy.

The Bank's office is located at Media House, Padge Road, Beeston, Nottingham, NG9 2 RS, and remote workers are responsible for covering commuting and accommodation costs when attending the office.

Salary & Benefits

Salary, dependent on skills and experience, between £30,000 and £35,000 with a pro-rata equivalent for a part-time role.

Salary sacrifice pension scheme: 9% of salary (up to £50,000) on an unmatched basis and up to 4% of total salary on a matched basis.

Other benefits in accordance with the Bank's People Policy on completion of probation, including travel loan scheme, electric vehicle salary sacrifice leasing scheme, enhanced maternity pay, payroll giving scheme, additional holiday purchase, private medical insurance, free eye tests, and death in service benefit.

Probation

The post is subject to a three months' probation period.

Closing Date

Sunday 29 November

Interview Date

Mid December

If you believe that you have the skills and the passion to join the Kingdom Bank team, please download the application pack and complete the application form for this role on our website

title: Marketing Executive
company: Future Prospects Group Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Content Marketing Executive
Newark/Mansfield (Outskirts), Full Time, Permanent
£30,000 per annum

Future Prospects Group are delighted to be working with our client in the sustainability sector to recruit a Content Marketing Executive on a full-time, permanent basis.

This is an exceptional opportunity for a creative storyteller who excels at turning complex technical concepts into engaging multi-channel content, driving brand awareness, and supporting commercial growth.

THE ROLE

Your responsibilities as a Content Marketing Executive will include:
- Taking full ownership of marketing channels to bring the brand to life across LinkedIn, YouTube, Facebook, the company website, and other platforms.
- Creating dynamic multi-media content, including written articles, video, interactive media, and informational guides that educate and drive action.
- Translating complex technical concepts into accessible, engaging stories that resonate with target audiences.
- Tracking content performance metrics and analysing data to continuously optimise reach, engagement, and commercial impact.
- Producing regular performance reports to communicate marketing effectiveness and insights back to key stakeholders.
- Leading the development of high-impact sales enablement tools and collateral to help the sales team engage prospects and win new business.
- Collaborating cross-functionally with internal teams and external agency partners to deliver cohesive, results-driven marketing campaigns.

THE CANDIDATE

The ideal Content Marketing Executive will be able to demonstrate the following key skills and experience:
- Proven experience of two to three years within a dedicated marketing content creation role.
- Strong hands-on video production expertise, with demonstrable experience across planning, filming, and editing.
- Advanced proficiency with design and multimedia tools, specifically Adobe Premiere Pro, Photoshop, Illustrator, and Canva.
- Exceptional copywriting and storytelling abilities, with a proven knack for simplifying complex technical ideas.
- Comprehensive understanding of social media channel management and digital content strategy.
- Solid capability to track, analyse, and report on content performance data to drive continuous improvement.
- A proactive, curious, and self-reliant approach with the confidence to take creative ownership and test new concepts.

THE BENEFITS

The benefits included with this Content Marketing Executive role are:
- A competitive starting salary of £30,000 per annum.
- Full-time, permanent employment offering stability and long-term career prospects.
- A creative environment where you have genuine ownership over multi-channel content direction.
- The opportunity to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and external marketing specialists.
- 20 days annual leave plus 8 bank holidays, with extra days accrued through service, plus a full Christmas shutdown.
- Employee Assistance Program
- Working with a passionate, friendly team of experts in a growing industry

Thank you for your interest in this vacancy and good luck with your application.

If you have not heard from a member of the Future Prospects team within 7 days from your application, please assume that your application has not been successful on this occasion. Unfortunately, due to the high volume of applications we receive, we are unable to provide individual feedback.

The services of Future Prospects are those of an Employment Agency.

title: Native German Speaking Content Marketing Executive
description:
MinsterFB is seeking Content Marketing Executive who is a native speaker of German. In this role, you will help create, maintain, and optimise product listings on Amazon. You will develop and refine listings to improve visibility and conversion across the UK and international marketplaces. You will gather and organise product information for new launches, manage listings through the Amazon process, and continuously enhance their look, feel, and performance for customers

Key Responsibilities

Your responsibilities will include:
- Create, review, and optimise content for German-speaking audiences, ensuring accuracy and relevance
- Creating new product lines and enhancing the digital shelf through text and image optimisation
- Identifying and resolving product setup issues
- Troubleshooting when products are not available for sale
- Conducting A/B tests to improve listing performance
- Supporting wider business needs as required

Desired Skills

We are looking for someone who is:
- Fluent in German, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Curious and proactive, willing to ask questions to understand challenges and solve problems
- Action-oriented, with the ability to get things done using the knowledge and tools provided
- Clear and direct in communication
- Able to work independently and manage their own workload
- Confident using PowerPoint, Word, and especially Excel
- Strong in both written and verbal communication
- Numerate and analytically capable

Desired Qualification:
- Ideally educated to degree level with evidence of strong mathematical ability and an interest in online/IT fields
- Non-graduates will also be considered if you can demonstrate success in a similar environment

Location:

This is an office-based role in our Southwell location for a minimum of two days per week. Hybrid working is supported through Zoom and Microsoft Teams, but face-to-face interaction is an important part of our culture.

For the first four weeks, you will be required in the office every day to meet the team and familiarise yourself with the business.

You may work from anywhere in the world for up to four consecutive weeks per year.

Salary & Other Benefits:
- £27,227 per annum
- 33 days annual holiday (including public holidays)
- 3pm finish every Friday
- Three-month unpaid sabbatical available after three years of continuous service
- Working hours: Monday-Thursday 9am-5:30pm, Friday 9am-3pm

Job Details:
- Work hours are, Monday to Thursday 9am until 5.30pm, Friday 9am until 3pm
- This job unapologetically online / on screen. However with the flexibility that fantastic global internet coverage provides you will be able to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 4 consecutive weeks a year
- In addition employees are entitled to a 3mth unpaid sabbatical after 4 years of continuous employment

About MinsterFB

MinsterFB works with iconic brands-including Grenade, Bisto, Yorkshire Tea, McVitie's and Cadbury-to grow their Amazon business. We provide account management, sales strategy, catalogue management, issue resolution, and training. We leverage the full suite of Amazon Seller and Vendor growth tools to deliver results.

As a Certified B Corporation, we are part of a global community committed to high standards of social and environmental performance.

How to Apply

If this role interests you, please attach your CV via the link provided.

To ensure your application is reviewed, include the phrase "I am able to work 2 days a week in Southwell"-preferably in the subject line.

MinsterFB values diversity and is committed to an inclusive recruitment process. We welcome applicants from underrepresented groups and encourage you to bring your whole self to work. If you require accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know.

title: Trainee Digital Marketing Manager No experience needed (Ref: 6901)
description:
DIGITAL MARKETING TRAINEESHIP (REMOTE)

Become a Digital Marketing Professional and Build Real-World Experience

Are you interested in digital marketing, online business, and helping organisations grow through effective marketing strategies? Do you want to gain practical experience while developing skills that employers are actively looking for?

We are offering a Digital Marketing Traineeship designed to help aspiring digital marketers develop industry-relevant knowledge through structured learning and practical projects.

What You Will Learn

Throughout the traineeship, you will develop an understanding of:
- Digital Marketing Fundamentals
- Marketing Strategy and Planning
- Search Engine Optimisation (SEO)
- Pay-Per-Click (PPC) Advertising
- Social Media Marketing
- Content Marketing
- Email Marketing
- Google Analytics and Marketing Analytics
- Conversion Rate Optimisation (CRO)
- Customer Journey Mapping
- Branding and Positioning
- Market Research and Competitor Analysis
- Artificial Intelligence (AI) for Marketing
- Marketing Automation
- Campaign Planning and Performance Measurement
- Marketing Reporting and Data Analysis

Practical Experience

You will work on realistic marketing projects that may include:
- Developing digital marketing strategies
- SEO audits and optimisation recommendations
- Social media campaign planning
- Content creation and marketing calendars
- Email marketing campaigns
- Marketing analytics and reporting
- Website optimisation projects
- Competitor research
- Brand positioning exercises
- Portfolio projects demonstrating your marketing skills

This practical experience will help you develop a professional portfolio that demonstrates your capabilities to future employers.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for individuals who:
- Have an interest in marketing, business, and technology
- Enjoy analysing data and solving problems
- Have good communication skills
- Are creative and eager to learn
- Can work independently and manage their time effectively
- Have basic computer skills

No previous digital marketing experience is required. Successful applicants will undertake our paid Digital Marketing training programme before progressing into employment. The cost of the training is the responsibility of the learner, and full guidance and support will be provided throughout the programme.

Benefits
- Remote and flexible learning
- Industry-relevant curriculum
- Portfolio development opportunities
- Practical project experience
- Mentoring and personalised feedback
- Career guidance and employability support
- Opportunity to develop skills sought by modern employers

Entry Requirements
- A good level of written English

- Motivation to learn and develop professionally

Career Opportunities

- Digital Marketing Executive

- PPC Executive
- Content Marketing Executive
- Social Media Executive
- Email Marketing Executive
- Marketing Coordinator
- Marketing Analyst
- Growth Marketing Executive
- Performance Marketing Executive
- Digital Marketing Assistant

Apply Today

If you are looking to start a career in Digital Marketing and want to gain practical experience while developing a professional portfolio, we would love to hear from you.

Submit your application today and begin your journey towards a career in one of the world's fastest-growing industries.

We advertise this role across multiple UK locations - you only need to apply once and you'll be considered for all of them.

title: Trainee Marketing Executive
description:
TRAINEE MARKETING EXECUTIVE
Nottingham, NG2 Full-Time In-Person Role

Launch your career in marketing no experience required.

Our client is growing their Nottingham team and wants to hear from ambitious, articulate individuals ready to start a career in marketing. As a Trainee Marketing Executive, you'll get hands-on experience across live campaigns, working directly with the public to represent well-known brands and bring marketing strategies to life in the real world.

This is a practical, fast-paced introduction to marketing you'll learn by doing, not by sitting through theory. Full training and mentoring are provided from day one.

- Representing client brands and campaigns directly to the public
- Learning how marketing campaigns are planned, delivered, and measured in practice
- Engaging customers and gathering feedback that shapes campaign performance
- Supporting the sales and sign-up process during live campaigns
- Working towards individual and team performance goals
- Taking part in structured training covering marketing fundamentals, communication, and campaign strategy

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR
- Strong communicators who are comfortable speaking with new people
- Individuals genuinely interested in a marketing career, not just a short-term job
